ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Bayer CropScience Limited has informed the BSE about its upcoming 68th Annual General Meeting (AGM) on August 19, 2026, to be held virtually, and is proactively notifying shareholders, particularly those without registered email addresses, on how to access the FY 2025-26 Annual Report online. The communication outlines critical dates for dividend entitlement, e-voting, and disbursement, alongside encouraging shareholders to update their details to claim any outstanding dividends. This is a routine regulatory compliance and shareholder communication, with no immediate red flags identified.
